name: Equal-weight mega-cap, phased rebalance
thesis: Own the six mega-cap platforms (AAPL, MSFT, GOOGL, AMZN, META, NVDA) at roughly equal weight so no single AI or consumer story dominates. Rebalance mechanically but phase the adds, so that a single-day narrative shock (like Oct 8) is not bought all at once.
regimeFit: Risk-on (SPY > 200d, VIX < 20): fully invested, cash ≤ 10%. Risk-on with an AI-capex shock: phase adds over ~1 week, least-extended first. SPY < 200d: no new adds; trims only.
entryRules: Buy the most underweight name whose RSI14 < 65 and that is not > 8% above its 50d SMA.
When several names are underweight, add the least-extended first; stage the rest across checks/days when timing is favorable (e.g. after an intraday pullback, not into a spike).
Avoid buying a name on the day it is the epicenter of negative news; re-check at a later check or the next day.
exitRules: Trim any name above the 25% hard cap back to ~25% the same day, timed at a check when the stock is not in a sharp down-gap (cap trims are exempt from the edge rule).
Soft-trim a name above 22% when RSI14 > 70.
No stop-losses on individual names (diversified long-only sleeve); risk is controlled by caps.
sizingRules: Target 1/6 ≈ 16.7% per name; hard cap 25% NAV per name.
No fixed order cap; be frugal (typically 0–2 orders a day). Each order must clear the 3× round-trip edge rule; minimum ticket $5.
Keep cash between 2% and 10% once fully phased in.
riskRules: Rates: if the 10y closes > 5.40%, pause adds for 2 sessions (stocks/yields correlation strongly negative).
Earnings: no adds to a name within 2 sessions before its earnings date.
personaConstraints: PAPER ONLY: no brokerage connection, no real orders.
Timing freedom: trade at any time during regular US market hours, chosen by the trader at a market-watch check (~every 20 min); no fixed sessions.
Universe: any US-listed stock or ETF that fits this persona's thesis; the watchlist is only the default scan. Off-watchlist or off-style buys need a written --persona-fit.
Hard guardrails: long-only cash (no margin, shorting, options, leveraged/inverse ETFs), cash never negative, concentration caps below, any single stock ≤ 25% NAV.
Every order needs same-day research (X, web, market sources) with a selected idea + thesis for the symbol, a rationale and confidence (enforced by scripts/paper-order.mjs).

Frugality: every order records target or expected move, stop or invalidation, horizon and estimated round-trip cost (slippage both ways + fees); rejected unless expected edge ≥ 3× round-trip cost. Above 3 trades/day or 10/week a --frequency-reason is required.
Holding is the default. Fills: latest Yahoo quote (may lag ~15 min) ± 5 bps slippage; Schwab $0 commission; SEC Section 31 + FINRA TAF on sells. Minimum ticket $5.
